decisions.reason: As a laboratory material close to the firm's core offering, the sunk development and channel investment still favor retention in 2022, even if results may have been mixed.

After several years, this lower-visibility accessory is the easiest line to discontinue because its strategic importance is limited and the firm can redirect resources to more central digital and custom-device products.
Its dedicated launch visibility and clear connection to digital dental workflows make management inclined to persist and justify earlier commitments rather than withdraw it now.
This custom earmold line sits very near the firm's core manufacturing capabilities and hearing-care channels, so commitment and fit strongly support continuing it.
Although somewhat more adjacent than the main earmold line, it still leverages established earmold know-how and customer channels, which makes management more likely to continue than to exit.
